description: INFO returns environment-specific strings (release version, OS version, system identifier, recalc mode, current directory, open file count). The values are intrinsically host-bound: Mac Excel 365 ja-JP returns Microsoft-version strings, Formulon returns its own engine identifier. Every probe is a documented divergence (`mode: skip-oracle`) — closure is a divergence-only declaration.

cases.skipped: INFO("release") returns the host application's version string; intrinsically environment-bound. Mac Excel 365 returns its build number, Formulon returns the engine version.
INFO("osversion") returns the host OS version string; intrinsically environment-bound.
INFO("system") returns the host OS family ("mac" / "pcdos" on Excel); intrinsically environment-bound.
INFO("numfile") returns the count of currently open workbooks; varies with host state.
INFO("recalc") returns the host application's recalculation mode ("Automatic" / "Manual"); Formulon has no notion of recalc mode.
